claude_command.label: Claude command
claude_command.description: Path or name of the claude binary. It must use the same CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR as Claude Desktop, or Desktop cannot find the session

folder.label: Working folder
folder.description: Folder the session runs in. Empty uses the launcher's own workspace (~/.local/state/noctalia-claude-launcher/workspace). Claude Desktop trusts this folder when it opens the session

model.label: Default model
model.description: Model the picker starts on. Custom ids from the Models list are reachable here only through 'First in list'

models.label: Models
models.description: Model ids the picker offers, in order

effort.label: Effort
effort.description: Reasoning level the picker starts on

allow_tools.label: Allow tools
allow_tools.description: On (default): the first turn uses claude's normal tools and permission mode. Off: the first turn runs with every tool disabled
